name: Hayes with Nørbak & CRAVO
description: For serious electronic music fans, Gare hosts a night of hard-hitting techno with local and international talent.
longDescription:
Gare Porto presents a night of electronic music on May 2, 2026, featuring Hayes alongside Nørbak and CRAVO. Hayes is known for his contributions to the contemporary techno scene, often incorporating driving rhythms and atmospheric textures into his sets. Nørbak, a Portuguese artist, has gained recognition for his raw and hypnotic techno productions, while CRAVO, also from Portugal, is celebrated for his dynamic and energetic performances within the genre. The lineup reflects a focus on artists who push the boundaries of hard-hitting electronic soundscapes.

Attendees can expect a focused club environment at Gare Porto, a venue recognized for its commitment to electronic music culture. The atmosphere is typically intense and immersive, catering to an audience with a strong interest in techno. The event is designed for dancing and experiencing extended DJ sets, characteristic of a dedicated nightlife experience.

This is a ticketed event. Gare Porto is located near the city center and is accessible via public transport. The venue is a short walk from the Lapa metro station.
